The collection of columns of Variables, holding numbers between operations (the memoir).
A column of discs holding one number with its sign; written V with a lower index for its place (Note B).
The number to the upper left of a V, counting the values the Variable has held (Note D).
A punched card naming the operation (+, −, ×, ÷) the mill is to perform (the memoir; Notes B, F).
A card naming the Variables that supply the mill and receive its result (Notes B, D, G).
The Variables a Variable-card connects to the mill, and those it directs the result to (Notes B, D).
Whether a number returns to its Variable after use, or the Variable is set to zero (Note D).
Variables holding results that are used again within the calculation (Notes D, G).
Variables on which final results are given; also Result-columns (Notes D, E, G).
A group of operations repeated; a cycle of cycles is a loop within a loop (Notes E, F, G).
Turning the cards back so that a group of them acts again, taken from the Jacquard-loom (Notes C, F).
